description: This file defines type aliases and macros for creating conformance profiles and archetypes used in type trait testing within the Abseil library. It includes macro definitions, profile aliases for various type traits, and composite profile templates.

methods.name: ABSL_INTERNAL_PROFILE_AND_ARCHETYPE_ALIAS
methods.description: Macro to define a profile and corresponding archetype with a given name and profile type.

methods.name: ExpandBasicProfiles
methods.description: Template alias to expand a receiver template with basic type profiles.

methods.name: ExpandBasicEquatableProfiles
methods.description: Template alias to expand a receiver template with basic equatable profiles.

methods.name: ExpandBasicComparableProfiles
methods.description: Template alias to expand a receiver template with basic comparable profiles.

methods.name: ExpandBasicHashableProfiles
methods.description: Template alias to expand a receiver template with basic hashable profiles.

methods.name: ExpandBasicDefaultConstructibleProfiles
methods.description: Template alias to expand a receiver template with default constructible profiles.

methods.name: ExpandSupportedProfiles
methods.description: Template alias to expand a receiver template with all supported profiles in Abseil.
